skill.summary: Production-grade Cypress E2E and component testing — selectors, network stubbing, auth, CI parallelization, flake elimination, Page Object Model, and TypeScr...

latestVersion.changelog:
Cypress Agent Skill v0.1.0 — initial release

- Adds quick-start guidance for Cypress E2E and component testing, including installation, configuration, and best practices.
- Covers robust selectors, retryable assertions, and best practices for test stability.
- Provides comprehensive recipes for stubbing network requests with cy.intercept.
- Documents authentication strategies, including cy.session and API-based login.
- Offers CI pipeline configuration tips and deep references for advanced patterns.
- User-invocable with built-in metadata for easy setup and integration.
